lines.t: Verse 1
I’ve been running circles trying just to feel enough
Smiling for the world while I’m breaking underneath the stuff
Every little failure felt like weight I couldn’t lift
Till YahuShua whispered, “Child, come rest a bit.”
I thought I had to fight alone
Carry every storm on my own
But in the quiet, I finally knew
I wasn’t meant to walk without You
Chorus
When the world got heavy, He held me first
Pulled me from the shadows when the fear got worse
All the pressure on me, yeah it almost hurt
But mercy found me — He held me first
Yeah, He held me first
Verse 2
People see the brave face, never see the hidden tears
I was drowning in the silence, trying just to persevere
But He stepped into the darkness, lit a fire in the night
Turned my trembling into confidence, my weakness into might
I thought I had to fight alone
Carry every storm on my own
But in the quiet, I finally knew
I wasn’t meant to walk without You
Chorus
When the world got heavy, He held me first
Pulled me from the shadows when the fear got worse
All the pressure on me, yeah it almost hurt
But mercy found me — He held me first
Yeah, He held me first
Too many voices tell me who I gotta be
But YahuShua broke the noise and said He’s fighting right for me
Yeah, the world tried to shake me, tried to get me reversed
But the King never left — yeah, He held me first
Now I rise, now I breathe, with a fire in my chest
Living fearless, ’cause I know I’m fully loved and fully blessed
I don’t bow to the pressure or the lies rehearsed
’Cause He claimed me, healed me — He held me first
In the silence, in the waiting
You were holding, You were shaping
Every moment, every word
All my healing — You held me first
All my healing — You held me first
